how: Beijing hosts several World Cube Association speedcubing competitions a year, such as Beijing Autumn Rivalry 2026 (1-3 Oct, up to 700 competitors) at a Wangjing hotel.
venue: WCA competition: Beijing Autumn Rivalry 2026 (Kun Tai Glory Hotel Beijing Wangjing)

how: The First Historical Archives of China holds Ming and Qing records, is open to international researchers, and opened a new public building near Tiananmen in 2022.
Guangji Temple, headquarters of the Chinese Buddhist Association, is an active temple where worshippers and monks pray in the courtyards and a guest centre receives visitors.
Cat Friends, active since 2001, keeps vaccinated and spayed stray cats for adoption and provides post-adoption medical support.
Jinghua Wushu Association teaches tai chi forms, qigong and meditation with teachers from Shaolin at a health club in Liangmaqiao (undated directory listing).
venue: Jinghua Wushu Association (Pulse Health Club, Kempinski Hotel Apartment)

how: Xuanlong Pool Hall in Hepingli is open 24 hours daily and other halls such as Pang Weiguo Billiards charge from about RMB 35 per hour for a snooker table.
Beijing Hikers runs guided weekend hikes in villages and hills near Beijing (for example a West Hills red-leaves route) with transport, snacks and a map included, open to everyone.
The Rainbow Radio-controlled Model Club flies model aircraft every Saturday at a light airfield in Bei An He, Changping, with beginner training classes at 11am.
A Beijing mental-health peer support group meets in the evening near Dongzhimen for about RMB 88 with no therapists present, and Alcoholics Anonymous also has a Beijing fellowship with no dues.
venue: Mental Health Peer Support Group (near Dongzhimen)

how: Beijing Hash House Harriers organise an easy Sunday run or walk from a different location around the city each week for about RMB 20, plus monthly out-of-town trips (listing may be dated).
The French Cultural Centre near Workers' Stadium has a 20,000-item library, reading club, cinema and cafe and offers French classes.
The Holiday Inn Lido health club includes a sauna, jacuzzi, pool and gym in its fee (10-visit card, monthly and annual memberships; undated listing).
Kite flying is a popular hobby in Beijing, with flyers using Olympic Park and the Guangqumen bridge area, and Three Stone Kites near Nanluoguxiang sells and crafts traditional kites (2017 feature).
venue: Olympic Park (Three Stone Kites shop, Nanluoguxiang)

how: C5sake Bar beside the C5art space in north Sanlitun serves sake flights and single glasses with bartender explanations of the types, and Sake Manzo lists over 30 sakes.

Recreational drone flying is allowed in Beijing but heavily restricted: drones over 250 g must be registered with the CAAC, flights are capped at 120 m within line of sight, and no-fly zones cover dense areas and airports (2019 guide).

Magician Fred Castelbranco performs close-up card magic at bars such as The Golden Weasel in Beijing, so the art can be seen and picked up informally, though no regular classes were found (2024 interview).
venue: The Golden Weasel (performances by Fred Castelbranco)

how: The annual BritCham Highland Games in Beijing, run with the Beijing Scottish Society, features bagpipes, ceilidh dancing and whisky tastings, but no regular piping tuition was found (2023 listing).
Pop-Up Beijing ran a two-hour origami (kusudama) workshop with supplies included for about RMB 125 in January 2016; only one-off workshops were found.
A King Sejong Institute (Korean language and culture centre) is listed in Beijing, and the Korean Cultural Service operates in the CBD on Guanghua Lu.
venue: King Sejong Institute Beijing / Korean Cultural Service

how: The Indian Embassy's Culture Centre on Guanghua Lu runs regular Bharatanatyam and Odissi classes, alongside yoga and an annual Vasant Mela cultural fair (2024 interview with the centre's director).
Local artists perform Kathak, Bharatanatyam and Odissi at the Indian Embassy's annual Vasant Mela in Beijing, but no regular Kathak class was found (2024 listing).
venue: Culture Centre, Embassy of India (Vasant Mela)

how: Tabla and sitar players take part in the Indian Embassy's annual Vasant Mela cultural stage in Beijing, but no regular tabla tuition was found (2024 listing).
venue: Culture Centre, Embassy of India (Vasant Mela)

how: Jessica's Craft Workshop in Wudaoying Hutong offers carpet tufting among its drop-in DIY workshops, alongside pottery, mosaics and candle making (2023 interview).
Jessica's Craft Workshop in Wudaoying Hutong runs one-on-one pottery-wheel workshops with firing and glazing, a craft version of clay modelling (2023 interview).

activity: Magic: The Gathering and trading card games
how: A Yu-Gi-Oh trading card group met every Friday and Monday at the Beijing Drum Tower Youth Hostel with rental decks available (2018 roundup of hobby groups).
venue: Beijing Drum Tower Youth Hostel (Yu-Gi-Oh group)

how: FabLab C+ is a digital-fabrication and maker lab inside the Beijing Jing Shan School near Wangfujing and is listed in the global FabLabs network; no Arduino-specific course was confirmed.
A Beijinger sports column lists lacrosse among the amateur team sports (with cricket, Aussie Rules, Gaelic football and hockey) that can be played in Beijing; no current club page was found (2009).
The Beijing Central Axis, a UNESCO World Heritage Site inscribed in 2024, links the Drum and Bell Towers, Jingshan, the Forbidden City, Tiananmen and Yongdingmen along a walkable north-south route.
Kombucha is brewed and sold locally by brands such as Papp's Tea and Sowhat and served at Kombucha Gunpowder House in Sanlitun; no home-brewing class was found (2018 guide).
